entries.title: Numbers 17:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

entries.title: Numbers 17:2
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, and get from them a rod from each father's house, all their leaders according to their fathers' houses-twelve rods. Write each man's name on his rod.

entries.title: Numbers 17:3
segments: "And you shall write Aaron's name on the rod of Levi. For there shall be one rod for the head of [each] father's house.

entries.title: Numbers 17:4
segments: "Then you shall place them in the tabernacle of meeting before the Testimony, where I meet with you.

entries.title: Numbers 17:5
segments: "And it shall be [that] the rod of the man whom I choose will blossom; thus I will rid Myself of the complaints of the children of Israel, which they make against you."

entries.title: Numbers 17:6
segments: So Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and each of their leaders gave him a rod apiece, for each leader according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods; and the rod of Aaron [was] among their rods.

entries.title: Numbers 17:7
segments: And Moses placed the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.

entries.title: Numbers 17:8
segments: ¶Now it came to pass on the next day that Moses went into the tabernacle of witness, and behold, the rod of Aaron, of the house of Levi, had sprouted and put forth buds, had produced blossoms and yielded ripe almonds.

entries.title: Numbers 17:9
segments: Then Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the children of Israel; and they looked, and each man took his rod.

entries.title: Numbers 17:10
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, "Bring Aaron's rod back before the Testimony, to be kept as a sign against the rebels, that you may put their complaints away from Me, lest they die."

entries.title: Numbers 17:11
segments: Thus did Moses; just as the LORD had commanded him, so he did.

entries.title: Numbers 17:12
segments: So the children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, "Surely we die, we perish, we all perish!

entries.title: Numbers 17:13
segments: "Whoever even comes near the tabernacle of the LORD must die. Shall we all utterly die?"
